etymarab.kok_maddesi: Back to library EtymArab * QṬ‑ قطـ BP – • © SG | 15Feb2021 √*QṬ- 2-cons. "root nucleus" to cut According to Ehret1995, this is the Ar reflex of a bi-consonantal »pre-Proto-Semitic« (pPS, i.e. preSem) root *ḲṬ- ‘to cut’, which in turn is from AfrAs AfrAs * k'âť‑ ‘to cut’. For 3-rad. extension see section DERIV below. – ▪ … ▪ … ▪ … ▪ … – According to Ehret1995#431, 3-radical extensions from the bi-consonantal "root nucleus" include: ► + »extendative« * ‑b => ↗ † QṬB ‘to cut’ ► + »finitive« * ‑l => ↗ qaṭala ‘to cut off, amputate, behead’ ► + »partive« * ‑ʕ => ↗ qaṭaʕa ‘to cut, cut off, lop, amputate’ Sources ; meta ; gram ; engl ; conc ; hist ; cogn ; disc ; west ; deriv ;
